HealthIA ONE one-take submission demo gate

enabled=true
Purpose: one controlled live, unmocked, approximately four-minute Chromium recording against the already deployed private Cloud Run service.
Cost policy: this commit intentionally enables exactly one recording attempt. It may spend a small number of Gemini requests but does not deploy a new Cloud revision.
Evidence policy: use synthetic patients/files only; never record secrets or identity tokens.
After-run policy: disable this trigger immediately after the controlled recording attempt, regardless of pass/fail.
